product_title: Royal Krishna Lotus Toran with Pearl Tassels (38 inches)
product_description: Elevate your entrance with this handcrafted traditional toran, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, a Lord Krishna centerpiece, decorative elephants, intricate golden detailing, and elegant pearl tassels with pink accents. Perfect for Diwali, Janmashtami, pooja rooms, weddings, and festive home décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle decorative motifs and pearl tassels carefully.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
